tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and lag signatures favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that adds relevant constraints beyond the five endpoints, reducing the risk of a fit that misses the 0.045 fresh-confirmation tolerance.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints can constrain a fit but leave no residual degrees of freedom to check it. With all horizons far above the pilot time scale, fast relaxation and coupling may trade off.
Neither law represents the observed transient lag or dependence on the initial field and stored memory.
It adds no trajectory evidence to distinguish fast relaxation from coupling.
